interpretation_en: foretells sickness and disagreeable people around you

cite.translation_ko: 여성이 샐러드를 만드는 꿈은, 연인이 변덕스럽고 다투기 좋아하게 될 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 행운과 즐거운 일들로 시간을 채울 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that much good luck and pleasant duties will employ your time

cite.original: Dreaming of salmon, denotes that much good luck and pleasant duties will employ your time.

interpretation_ko: 명랑하고 넉넉히 부양해 줄 남자와 혼인할 조짐
interpretation_en: foretells that she will marry a cheerful man, with means to keep her comfortable

cite.original: For a young woman to eat it, foretells that she will marry a cheerful man, with means to keep her comfortable.
cite.translation_ko: 여성이 연어를 먹는 꿈은, 명랑하고 넉넉히 부양해 줄 남자와 혼인할 조짐이다

interpretation_en: is an omen of discordant surroundings when seen in dreams. You will usually find after dreaming of salt that everything goes awry, and quarrels and dissatisfaction show themselves in the family circle

cite.original: Salt is an omen of discordant surroundings when seen in dreams. You will usually find after dreaming of salt that everything goes awry, and quarrels and dissatisfaction show themselves in the family circle.

interpretation_en: portends that debts and mortgages will harass you

interpretation_en: denotes change in your living will add loss to some unconquerable grief

cite.original: To dream of saltpeter, denotes change in your living will add loss to some unconquerable grief.
cite.translation_ko: 초석 꿈은, 생활의 변화가 이겨낼 수 없는 슬픔에 손실을 더할 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes you will prosper under adverse circumstances and convert enemies into friends

cite.translation_ko: 연고 꿈은, 역경 속에서도 번영하고 적을 벗으로 바꿀 조짐이다

cite.original: To dream of receiving merchandise samples, denotes improvement in your business.

interpretation_ko: 사업에서 곤란해지거나 애정 문제로 곤경에 빠질 조짐
interpretation_en: implies he will find himself embarrassed in business affairs, or in trouble through love engagements

cite.translation_ko: 여행하는 남자가 견본을 잃어버리는 꿈은, 사업에서 곤란해지거나 애정 문제로 곤경에 빠질 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 즐길 거리를 바꿔 볼 기회가 생길 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes she will have chances to vary her amusements

cite.original: For a woman to dream that she is examining samples sent her, denotes she will have chances to vary her amusements.
cite.translation_ko: 여성이 받은 견본을 살펴보는 꿈은, 즐길 거리를 바꿔 볼 기회가 생길 조짐이다

interpretation_en: is indicative of famine and losses

cite.original: To dream of sand, is indicative of famine and losses.

interpretation_en: denotes that you will estrange yourself from friends in order to investigate hidden subjects, taking up those occupying the minds of cultured and progressive thinkers

cite.original: To dream of Sanskrit, denotes that you will estrange yourself from friends in order to investigate hidden subjects, taking up those occupying the minds of cultured and progressive thinkers.

cite.original: To dream of sapphire, is ominous of fortunate gain, and to woman, a wise selection in a lover.

interpretation_en: is ominous of, to woman, a wise selection in a lover

cite.translation_ko: 여성이 정어리를 상에 올리는 꿈은, 탐탁잖은 사람의 관심에 시달릴 조짐이다
